description.value: East West Market is an independent, community-focused grocery store that has served Vancouver's Main Street neighbourhood since 1996, now under owner David Lee Kwen who grew up helping run a family grocery in Trinidad and Tobago. The store stocks over 1,100 products spanning fresh produce, artisan deli meats and cheeses, bakery, frozen goods, and a strong vegan section, with a focus on sustainability and local economy. A second location in Kerrisdale has since opened, reflecting the store's popularity across the city.
